page.title: 論理の道しるべを選ぶ

analysis.summaryJa: 結果・追加・例示・言い換え・対比を示す接続表現と、文副詞としての句読法を学ぶ。
grammarPoints: that is/in other wordsで言い換える
文副詞の句読法に注意する
visualEvidence: 結果・追加・例示・明確化・対比の区分
commonTraps: howeverをカンマだけで独立節間に置く
in other wordsを追加と誤解する

questions.prompt: The shipment missed the cutoff time; -------, it will leave tomorrow.
questions.translationJa: 荷物は締切に間に合わなかったため、明日出発します。
questions.explanationJa: 前件から結果を導くためthereforeです。

questions.prompt: The hotel offers free breakfast. -------, guests can use the gym at no charge.
questions.translationJa: ホテルは無料朝食を提供します。さらにジムも無料です。
questions.explanationJa: 追加情報なのでMoreoverです。

questions.prompt: Several teams use the platform; -------, sales tracks customer requests with it.
questions.translationJa: 複数チームが利用しています。例えば営業部は顧客依頼を追跡しています。
questions.explanationJa: 具体例なのでfor exampleです。

questions.prompt: We need two backup servers; -------, one server is not enough.
questions.translationJa: バックアップサーバーが2台必要です。つまり1台では足りません。
questions.explanationJa: 言い換えなのでin other wordsです。

questions.prompt: The venue is near the station. -------, it has ample parking.
questions.translationJa: 会場は駅に近く、さらに駐車場も十分あります。
questions.explanationJa: 追加の利点なのでIn additionです。

questions.prompt: The first supplier offered the lowest price; -------, its delivery time was the longest.
questions.translationJa: 最初の業者は最安でした。しかし納期は最長でした。
questions.explanationJa: 対比なのでhoweverです。

questions.prompt: The training room lacks video equipment; -------, we will use the auditorium.
questions.translationJa: 研修室には映像設備がないため、その結果、大講堂を使います。
questions.explanationJa: 結果を示すconsequentlyが適切です。

questions.prompt: The service includes premium features; -------, users receive priority support.
questions.translationJa: プレミアム機能があります。例えば優先サポートです。
questions.explanationJa: 具体例なのでfor instanceです。

questions.prompt: Applications are due Friday; -------, late submissions will not be reviewed.
questions.translationJa: 申請は金曜締切です。したがって遅れた申請は審査されません。
questions.explanationJa: 結論を導くためthereforeです。

questions.prompt: The contract covers routine maintenance. -------, emergency repairs cost extra.
questions.translationJa: 通常保守は対象ですが、緊急修理は別料金です。
questions.explanationJa: 対比なのでHoweverです。

questions.prompt: Choose the correctly punctuated sentence.

choices.A: The road was flooded; therefore, delivery was delayed.
choices.B: The road was flooded, therefore delivery was delayed.
choices.C: The road was flooded therefore, delivery was delayed.
choices.D: The road was flooded because therefore delivery was delayed.

questions.translationJa: 道路冠水のため配送が遅れました。
questions.explanationJa: thereforeは文副詞なのでセミコロンとコンマが適切です。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence with moreover.

choices.A: The software is easy, moreover it is inexpensive.
choices.B: The software is easy. Moreover, it is inexpensive.
choices.C: The software is easy because moreover it is inexpensive.
choices.D: The software is easy moreover, inexpensive.

questions.translationJa: ソフトは使いやすく、さらに安価です。
questions.explanationJa: Moreoverを文副詞として正しく使っています。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence giving an example.

choices.A: Several services are available therefore printing is offered.
choices.B: Several services are available however printing is offered.
choices.C: Several services are available; for example, printing is offered.
choices.D: Several services are available in other words printing is offered.

questions.translationJa: 複数サービスがあります。例えば印刷です。
questions.explanationJa: 具体例をfor exampleで示しています。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct clarification.

choices.A: The plan is flexible. Moreover, dates can change.
choices.B: The plan is flexible. Therefore, dates can change as a definition.
choices.C: The plan is flexible. For example, this is identical wording.
choices.D: The plan is flexible; in other words, dates can be adjusted.

questions.translationJa: 計画は柔軟です。つまり日程を調整できます。
questions.explanationJa: 言い換えなのでin other wordsが適切です。

questions.prompt: Choose the correctly punctuated sentence with however.

choices.A: The estimate was low; however, the client chose another supplier.
choices.B: The estimate was low, however the client chose another supplier.
choices.C: The estimate was low however, the client chose another supplier.
choices.D: The estimate was low because however the client chose another supplier.

questions.translationJa: 見積もりは安かったですが、顧客は別業者を選びました。
questions.explanationJa: howeverは等位接続詞ではないためこの句読法が適切です。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence with consequently.

choices.A: The system failed consequently, users lost access.
choices.B: The system failed; consequently, users lost access.
choices.C: The system failed, consequently users lost access.
choices.D: Consequently the system failed because users lost access.

questions.translationJa: システム故障の結果、利用者はアクセスできませんでした。
questions.explanationJa: 結果と句読法が正しいです。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence adding a second benefit.

choices.A: The package includes support. However, it includes upgrades.
choices.B: The package includes support. Therefore, it includes upgrades.
choices.C: The package includes support. In addition, it includes upgrades.
choices.D: The package includes support. For example, it includes unrelated upgrades.

questions.translationJa: サポートに加えてアップグレードも含まれます。
questions.explanationJa: 追加なのでIn additionです。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence giving one example from a category.

choices.A: We serve international clients; therefore, a German retailer joined us.
choices.B: We serve international clients; however, a German retailer joined us.
choices.C: We serve international clients; in other words, one retailer exists.
choices.D: We serve international clients; for instance, a German retailer joined us last month.

questions.translationJa: 海外顧客に対応しています。例えば先月ドイツの小売業者が加わりました。
questions.explanationJa: 具体例なのでfor instanceです。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence with that is as clarification.

choices.A: The deadline is fixed; that is, extensions are not allowed.
choices.B: The deadline is fixed; moreover, extensions are not allowed as a restatement.
choices.C: The deadline is fixed; for example, extensions are not allowed as a conclusion.
choices.D: The deadline is fixed; therefore, fixed simply repeats itself.

questions.translationJa: 締切は固定です。つまり延長不可です。
questions.explanationJa: that isが明確化しています。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence signaling contrast.

choices.A: The device is compact. Moreover, it is hard to repair.
choices.B: The device is compact. However, it is hard to repair.
choices.C: The device is compact. Therefore, it is hard to repair.
choices.D: The device is compact. For instance, it is hard to repair.

questions.translationJa: 装置は小型ですが修理は難しいです。
questions.explanationJa: 対比なのでHoweverです。

questions.prompt: Choose the closest meaning to: "The road was closed; therefore, we changed the route."

choices.A: The closure led to the route change.
choices.B: The route change caused the closure.
choices.C: The closure is an example of a route.

questions.translationJa: 道路閉鎖がルート変更につながりました。
questions.explanationJa: thereforeは結果を示します。

questions.prompt: Choose the closest meaning to: "The room is spacious. Moreover, it has excellent lighting."

choices.B: Lighting is an additional positive feature.
choices.D: Lighting is an example of space.

questions.translationJa: 照明は追加の長所です。
questions.explanationJa: Moreoverは追加を示します。

questions.prompt: Choose the closest meaning to: "We offer several payment methods; for example, customers may pay by card."

choices.A: Card is the result of several methods.
choices.C: Card is one example of available methods.

questions.translationJa: カード払いは支払い方法の一例です。
questions.explanationJa: for exampleが具体例を示します。

questions.prompt: Choose the closest meaning to: "We need redundancy; in other words, one backup is not enough."

choices.A: One backup is an example of redundancy.
choices.D: The second statement restates the first.

questions.translationJa: 2文目は1文目を言い換えています。
questions.explanationJa: in other wordsの役割です。

questions.prompt: Choose the closest meaning to: "The fee is low; however, the cancellation policy is strict."

choices.A: The strict policy contrasts with the low fee.
choices.C: The policy is an example of the fee.

questions.translationJa: 低料金と厳しい規定が対比されています。
questions.explanationJa: howeverは対比です。

questions.prompt: Choose the closest meaning to: "Demand increased; consequently, the factory added a shift."

choices.B: Higher demand resulted in an added shift.
choices.C: The shift is an example of demand.

questions.translationJa: 需要増の結果シフトが追加されました。
questions.explanationJa: consequentlyは結果です。

questions.prompt: Choose the closest meaning to: "The system offers useful tools; for instance, it can generate weekly reports."

choices.A: Reports are the consequence of all tools.
choices.C: Weekly reports are one concrete example.

questions.translationJa: 週次レポート生成は具体例です。
questions.explanationJa: for instanceが例を示します。

questions.prompt: Choose the closest meaning to: "The policy applies to contractors; that is, temporary external staff must follow it too."

choices.C: The policy is caused by temporary staff.
choices.D: The second clause clarifies who is included.

questions.translationJa: 後半が対象者を明確化しています。
questions.explanationJa: that isによる明確化です。

questions.prompt: Choose the closest meaning to: "The office is central. In addition, it is open Saturdays."

choices.A: Saturday opening is another useful feature.
choices.D: Location is an example of Saturday opening.

questions.translationJa: 土曜営業は追加の利点です。
questions.explanationJa: In additionは追加です。

questions.prompt: Choose the closest meaning to: "The first option is cheaper; however, the second is more reliable."

choices.A: Reliability is an example of cheapness.
choices.B: The options are contrasted on different strengths.

questions.translationJa: 二つの選択肢を異なる長所で対比しています。
questions.explanationJa: howeverが対比を示します。

questions.prompt: The meeting was moved online. -------, no one needs to travel today.
questions.translationJa: 会議はオンラインになりました。したがって移動不要です。
questions.explanationJa: 結果なのでThereforeです。

questions.prompt: The new plan reduces shipping costs. -------, it shortens delivery time.
questions.translationJa: 新計画は輸送費を減らし、さらに納期も短縮します。
questions.explanationJa: 追加なのでMoreoverです。

questions.prompt: Several employees travel often. -------, Ms. Brown visits overseas clients monthly.
questions.translationJa: 頻繁に出張する社員がいます。例えばブラウンさんです。
questions.explanationJa: 具体例なのでFor exampleです。

questions.prompt: The warranty covers manufacturing defects only. -------, accidental damage is excluded.
questions.translationJa: 製造上の欠陥のみ対象です。つまり事故損傷は対象外です。
questions.explanationJa: 言い換えなのでIn other wordsです。

questions.prompt: The first candidate has more experience. -------, the second has stronger technical skills.
questions.translationJa: 1人目は経験豊富ですが、2人目は技術力が高いです。
questions.explanationJa: 対比なのでHoweverです。

questions.prompt: The factory lost power for three hours; -------, output fell below target.
questions.translationJa: 3時間停電し、その結果生産量が目標を下回りました。
questions.explanationJa: 結果なのでconsequentlyです。

questions.prompt: The kit contains several safety items; -------, gloves and goggles are included.
questions.translationJa: 安全用品がいくつかあります。例えば手袋とゴーグルです。
questions.explanationJa: 具体例なのでfor instanceです。

questions.prompt: The office is convenient for commuters. -------, nearby parking is limited.
questions.translationJa: 通勤には便利ですが、近隣駐車場は限られます。
questions.explanationJa: 対比なのでHoweverです。

questions.prompt: All visitors must register. -------, no guest may enter the work area without a badge.
questions.translationJa: 全来訪者は登録が必要です。したがってバッジなしでは入れません。
questions.explanationJa: 規則から結論を導くためThereforeです。

questions.prompt: The subscription includes cloud storage. -------, users receive automatic backups.
questions.translationJa: クラウド保存に加え、自動バックアップも提供されます。
questions.explanationJa: 追加なのでIn additionです。
